title: Discussing a deadline in a contract

vocabulary.example: The delivery date is stated in section three.
vocabulary.example_cz: Termín dodání je uveden v části tři.
vocabulary.tts_text: The delivery date is stated in section three.

vocabulary.example: There is a penalty clause for late delivery.
vocabulary.example_cz: Existuje sankční doložka za pozdní dodání.
vocabulary.tts_text: There is a penalty clause for late delivery.

vocabulary.example: Late delivery would put us in breach of contract.
vocabulary.example_cz: Pozdní dodání by znamenalo porušení smlouvy.
vocabulary.tts_text: Late delivery would put us in breach of contract.

vocabulary.example: Let's stick to the agreed timeline.
vocabulary.tts_text: Let's stick to the agreed timeline.

vocabulary.example: Please notify us in advance of any delay.
vocabulary.example_cz: Prosím informujte nás předem o jakémkoli zpoždění.
vocabulary.tts_text: Please notify us in advance of any delay.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: The delivery date in the contract is next Monday. Can we meet the deadline?
lines.text_cz: Termín dodání ve smlouvě je příští pondělí. Dokážeme ho dodržet?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: It will be tight. Is there a grace period?
lines.text_cz: Bude to napjaté. Existuje dodatečná lhůta?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: A short one, but late delivery could put us in breach of contract.
lines.text_cz: Krátká, ale pozdní dodání by mohlo znamenat porušení smlouvy.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Understood. Is there a penalty clause?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Yes, so please notify us in advance if there's any issue.
lines.text_cz: Ano, takže nás prosím předem informujte, pokud nastane problém.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: We'll stick to the agreed timeline.
